newsitem.title: BOSNIA: Explosion in town of police chief killed by NATO.
newsitem.headline: Explosion in town of police chief killed by NATO.

text.p: A grenade exploded near the offices of international police monitors in the north Bosnian town of Prijedor early on Wednesday.
International police spokesman Alun Roberts said it caused slight damage to a car.
It was the third blast in the Bosnian Serb republic since former Prijedor police chief Simo Drljaca was shot dead by NATO troops a week ago while resisting arrest as a war crimes suspect.
Peacekeepers have been on alert against a Serb backlash since the death of Drljaca and another Serb who was arrested and taken to the U.N. war crimes tribunal in the Netherlands.
